name: Example: Kenney sedan and Poly Haven asphalt
author: Kenney (car), Poly Haven (asphalt); packaged as an example
description: Made from two files that are already in this repository. Copy src/assets/models/vehicle-sedan.glb as car.glb and src/assets/textures/cc0/asphalt/{color,normal,rough}_1k.jpg as road_color.jpg, road_normal.jpg, road_rough.jpg beside this file, then drop the folder on the Mods panel.
